banks: random clipped standard normal with original packed random U32 and finite signed E4M3 scales
all16 E2M1 nibbles, signed zeros and onehot lane/block boundaries, repeated rows
extra: T5 code-bank row permutation [4,2,0,3,1] per shape
references: Each native mx.quantized_matmul invocation uses one row M1; concatenate only after separate M1 operator calls. Original expression custom control is compared separately before candidate. No output is an input to candidate.
gate: BF16 shape/dtype/finite + every byte including signedzero; record per-row hashes. First failed reference finite check is INVALID_FIXTURE rather than a candidate failure. First control or candidate mismatch stops all remaining cases, saves diagnosis; no tolerances.
readonly: Before/after sourcecontrol, candidate and finally: complete W/scales/X hashes, shapes/dtypes/observed canonical zero-copy buffer strides and object identities. No W copy/repack in prepare.
resource_policy: root owns GPU/process/timeout; worker raw outside-case snapshots first, then original guard; AC, thermal0/1, pressure1, known-foreign-none, swapMB no growth, Swapouts stable. Root may impose stricter nominal0 outer guard.
partial_N: not supported by frozen target-only helper; CPU guard rejects N49 and N56, no partial-tile GPU claim
